hits.probe:
base=$(git merge-base HEAD {upstream_remote}/{upstream_branch}) || exit 1
comm -12 \
  <(git diff --name-only -z "$base" HEAD | tr '\0' '\n' | sort -u) \
  <(git diff --name-only -z "$base" {upstream_remote}/{upstream_branch} | tr '\0' '\n' | sort -u) \
| grep -Eq '(^|/)([^/]*\.lock|package-lock\.json|yarn\.lock|pnpm-lock\.yaml|go\.sum|Cargo\.lock|poetry\.lock|Pipfile\.lock|composer\.lock|Gemfile\.lock|mix\.lock|pubspec\.lock)$'

base=$(git merge-base HEAD {upstream_remote}/{upstream_branch}) || exit 1
while IFS= read -r f; do
  [ -n "$f" ] || continue
  case "$f" in
    *.lock|*/package-lock.json|package-lock.json|*/yarn.lock|yarn.lock|*/pnpm-lock.yaml|pnpm-lock.yaml|*/go.sum|go.sum|*/Cargo.lock|Cargo.lock|*/poetry.lock|poetry.lock|*/Pipfile.lock|Pipfile.lock|*/composer.lock|composer.lock|*/Gemfile.lock|Gemfile.lock|*/mix.lock|mix.lock|*/pubspec.lock|pubspec.lock) ;;
    *) continue ;;
  esac
  git cat-file -e "$base:$f" 2>/dev/null || continue
  git cat-file -e "HEAD:$f" 2>/dev/null || continue
  git cat-file -e "{upstream_remote}/{upstream_branch}:$f" 2>/dev/null || continue
  if comm -12 \
      <(comm -23 <(git show "$base:$f" | sort -u) <(git show "{upstream_remote}/{upstream_branch}:$f" | sort -u)) \
      <(git show "HEAD:$f" | sort -u) | grep -q .; then
    exit 0
  fi
done < <(comm -12 \
  <(git diff --name-only -z "$base" HEAD | tr '\0' '\n' | sort -u) \
  <(git diff --name-only -z "$base" {upstream_remote}/{upstream_branch} | tr '\0' '\n' | sort -u))
exit 1
